commands.coverage: T="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/quality-tools"; { test -x "$T/dotnet-coverage" || dotnet tool install --tool-path "$T" dotnet-coverage --version 18.11.0; } && { test -x "$T/reportgenerator" || dotnet tool install --tool-path "$T" dotnet-reportgenerator-globaltool --version 5.5.11; } && "$T/dotnet-coverage" collect --settings dotnet-coverage.settings.xml --output coverage/coverage.cobertura.xml --output-format cobertura -- dotnet test Orkeon.sln -c Release --no-build --filter "Category!=Integration&Category!=Slow" && "$T/reportgenerator" -reports:coverage/coverage.cobertura.xml -targetdir:coverage/report -reporttypes:TextSummary "-assemblyfilters:-*.Tests;-Orkeon.Tests.Shared;-Orkeon.Examples*"
docs_checks: docfx metadata docfx.json && docfx build docfx.json --warningsAsErrors

checklist: The branch is not main and follows feature|fix|chore/<slug>
dotnet build Orkeon.sln -warnaserror is green; a new public API is declared in its project's PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt (RS0016/RS0017)
A changed public signature also builds examples/Orkeon.Examples.sln with -warnaserror
Tests added or updated for a behaviour change, and the fast suite passes (Category!=Integration&Category!=Slow)
Docs updated when behaviour or configuration changes, French mirror included (bash scripts/check-docs-parity.sh)
CHANGELOG.md has an entry under [Unreleased] for anything user-visible
New shell or shebang scripts carry the executable bit in the index (git update-index --chmod=+x)
No credential, token or key in the diff (the secret scan runs gitleaks over the PR history)
No direct System.IO in framework code (IFileSystemService; the VFS analyzer enforces it)
Comments are English and carry no accented letter (python3 scripts/check-comment-accents.py)
Commit messages follow type(scope) summary, in English
First contribution - the CLA check asks for one sentence

channels.name: github-release
channels.check: gh release view v<version> --repo Orkeon/orkeon --json isDraft,isPrerelease,assets - published, prerelease when the version holds '-', every asset named once in SHA256SUMS or SHA256SUMS.msi (bash scripts/check-release-assets.sh --assets <names file> --no-hash <dir> SHA256SUMS SHA256SUMS.msi)

channels.name: release-verify
channels.check: jobs verify-published / verify-deb, verify-macos, verify-checksums of the release.yml run on the tag - all success

channels.name: apt
channels.check: jobs verify-apt / verify-apt (<channel>, ...) of the release.yml run - channel rc for every tag, stable too when the version holds no '-'

channels.name: msi
channels.check: assets orkeon-<version>-win-x64.msi and orkeon-host-<version>-win-x64.msi listed in SHA256SUMS.msi; an install from the published MSI is pasted by the user (no verify job runs on Windows)

channels.name: archives
channels.check: assets orkeon-<version>-<rid>.tar.gz|zip and orkeon-cli-<version>-<rid>.tar.gz|zip, the .deb, orkeon-<version>.sbom.cdx.json and orkeon-typings-<version>.tar.gz listed in SHA256SUMS

channels.name: nuget
channels.check: curl -s https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/<id lowercased>/index.json lists <version> for Orkeon, Orkeon.Tools, Orkeon.Rag.Onnx, Orkeon.Rag.Onnx.Model, Orkeon.Tools.Embeddings.Local, Orkeon.Scripting.Cli, Orkeon.Compliance.Vfs, Orkeon.Interop.AgentFramework, Orkeon.Hosting.Aspire

channels.name: ghcr
channels.check: ghcr.io/orkeon/orkeon-runners:<version> resolves (anonymous pull token from https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:orkeon/orkeon-runners:pull, then HEAD /v2/orkeon/orkeon-runners/manifests/<version>); the tag is an index of linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, which release.yml checks itself after the push
